rule: Every published figure, tool response and benchmark ground truth cites exactly one universe_id. A figure without a universe_id is not citable. Two figures for the same metric are only 'in conflict' if they cite the same universe_id. Rule added 2026-09-15: a universe is declared before its figures exist; a definition reconstructed from a figure is not canonical (cited_external at most). Data present means in-universe unless an exclusion is written in the definition.
